agent_data_note: Use purified PairSmell inputs via `dataset_candidate/pairsmell/` (~20 project directories; each has snapshot subdirs). Do **not** invent synthetic graphs or restore deleted `_Agreement/` labels (smell_4.csv / insep_smell_4.csv).
benchmark_rules: PairSmell data is available at `dataset_candidate/pairsmell/` (workspace symlink; use this path for ls/read_file and for $PAIRSMELL_HOME in scripts).
Detect InSep/InCol from modularization outputs (ACDC/FCA/WCA_LIMBO) vs folder modules yourself.
Forbidden: reading `_Agreement/`, `smell_4.csv`, `insep_smell_4.csv`, or fabricating commit/dependency data.
Computation should use standard Python tooling (pandas/numpy/networkx/pydriller as needed).
If the full 20-project package is incomplete, document the blocker and use an explicit subset with evidence.
Detection of InSep/InCol must remain automated and must not rely on developer annotations.
non_goals: Using sample_*.csv or toy graphs as the main evaluation data
Reading / restoring author precomputed PairSmell CSVs under `_Agreement/`
Claiming full 20-project / 473-snapshot reproduction without the mounted package
Manual ground-truth modular structure labels for smell detection
